    hy = observation['grid_height']

    ox, oy = observation['opponent_position']
    resources = observation['resources']
    obstacles = set((x, y) for x, y in observation['obstacles'])
    score_self, score_opp = observation['scores']
    res_count = observation['remaining_resource_count']

    def dist(a, b): return abs(a[0]-b[0]) + abs(a[1]-b[1])
    def safe(x, y): return 0 <= x < wx and 0 <= y < hy and (x, y) not in obstacles

    target = None
    min_res_dist = None
    for r in resources:

        if safe(*rpos):

                target = rpos

    if target:
        dx = target[0] - px
        dy = target[1] - py

        move_y = (1 if dy > 0 else -1) if dy != 0 else 0

    odx = ox - px

    if score_self >= score_opp and safe(px + (1 if odx > 0 else -1 if odx < 0 else 0),

        return [(1 if odx > 0 else -1 if odx < 0 else 0),
                (1 if ody > 0 else -1 if ody < 0 else 0)]
    else:

        dy = -1 if ody > 0 else 1 if ody < 0 else 0
